tools.name: account
tools.title: Check or manage a BrewPage connection
tools.description: Check connection status, view masked tokens or change account publishing access. Use status with requireAccount=true to request a connection.

token.description: Owner token to add using existing admin proof

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

tools.name: delete_page_data
tools.title: Delete page data entries
tools.description: Permanently delete entries or uploaded files from one list. Select docIds, fileIds, a timestamp range or all=true.

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

all.description: Explicit true deletes all entries and files

tools.name: delete_publication
tools.title: Delete a BrewPage publication or KV key
tools.description: Permanently delete the exact publication. For KV, specify key to delete that key only. Deleting the last key also removes the store. Omitting key deletes the entire store. A secret ({"kind":"secret","id":<ref>} or its manage link): a working link stops working at once, then its record leaves your list.

kind.description: Publication kind returned by publish or list; secret with its ref as id

id.description: Publication id, or a secret's 10-character ref

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

tools.name: domains
tools.title: Manage custom domains
tools.description: List, add, attach, check, detach or remove custom domains. Attach requires a hostname and an HTML page or site target. Set the returned DNS records at the provider, then check once and read status with get. Detach keeps the hostname registered.

hostname.description: Bare hostname, e.g. schedule.example.org. Required to add, attach or detach

tools.name: get_guide
tools.title: Read a BrewPage guide
tools.description: Get a short workflow for publishing, Page data, templates (forms, polls, quizzes, games, flashcards, habit trackers, to-do planners, movie clubs), custom domains or account connection. Use limits or stats for current platform data.

q.description: A few words about the desired template

tools.name: list_publications
tools.title: List BrewPage publications
tools.description: List publications you own by cursor, or search the public gallery by page. Your items carry your private tags; tag filters by one. Your first page also carries secretCounts and, when you have one-time secrets, a secrets group; kind secret lists only them (ended picks the group). Results can include author-written titles.

kind.description: Mine only. Publication kind, or secret

ended.description: Mine only, secrets. false (default): active secrets, newest first; true: ended ones

tag.description: Mine only. Exact tag, any case

expiring.description: Mine only. Expiring within seven days

cursor.description: Mine only. nextCursor from the previous result

tools.name: notifications
tools.title: Manage BrewPage notifications
tools.description: List your profile notices and publication activity, mark items read, or change profile and page notification settings. Types: page_expiring, page_removed, page_taken_down, page_restored, page_link_changed, page_deleted, page_extended, entries_new, quota_close, quota_reached, published, updated, domain_problem, domain_paused, domain_active, domain_lost, domain_released, secret_opened, secret_expired, secret_deleted, news. Links with rel page, data, manage or domain open the owner's signed-in pages (a secret's manage link: its account page): give them only to the user, privately.

entries.description: true or false overrides the page switch; null restores the default

tools.name: publication_settings
tools.title: Change publication settings
tools.description: Change listing, badge, title, tags, password, storage, hosting, link name or Page data on an owned publication. Use a disruptive action alone. Ask before make_private or make_public: the current address stops working (after make_public it leads to the new one for 30 days). A secret ({"kind":"secret","id":<ref>} or its manage link) takes title, note and tags only.

id.description: ID from the publication receipt, or a secret's 10-character ref

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

kind.description: Publication kind, or secret: then only title, note and tags

note.description: Secrets only. Your own note; "" clears it

action.description: Use alone. make_private and make_public move it to a new address; make_private and rotate_link end the old address and any link name for good; make_private detaches a custom domain

listed.description: List or unlist an eligible public publication

badgeHidden.description: Hide or show the BrewPage badge

title.description: One-line title; empty restores the content title

extend.description: Set true to extend storage to the profile limit

linkName.description: Readable name for the public link of a page, site or file: 6-20 of a-z, 0-9 and hyphens, with a letter; null removes it. Needs a profile token, or an owner token added to a free BrewPage profile

state.description: {} enables Page data, named rules merge, null disables and keeps entries

tags.description: Your private tags, replacing the set; [] clears. Up to 10, 1-32 characters, no commas, saved lowercase. Needs a profile publication

tools.name: publish
tools.title: Publish on BrewPage
tools.description:
Shared public namespace: public:true (or namespace:"public"); ordinary link-only: omit both. HTML: content; kind=site: files; kind=file: url; kind=json: json; kind=kv: key,value. Site: {"kind":"site","public":true,"files":[{"path":"index.html","content":"

Hi

"}]}. A public input URL does not request listing. New HTML titles go in ; preserve supplied HTML. For visitor input read get_guide topic page-data first; publish HTML and state together. Use domain for an owned hostname, linkName for a readable public link. To share a password or key: {"kind":"secret","title":"...","text":"..."}, a private link that stops working after maxViews openings; returns its owner token and manage link.

kind.description: Default html. secret: one-time secret link from title and text (optional filename, note, tags, ttl, maxViews, ownerToken)

format.description: HTML only. html, markdown or a code language

verbatim.description: Preserve inline source by default. False allows paste repair.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL fetched directly by the tool. No local download needed.

json.description: Pass objects/arrays directly: {"x":1}. Strings are stored as strings.

tags.description: Tags. Updates accept tags only on HTML and sites

state.description: Page data configuration for HTML-format pages and sites. {} enables, null disables on update

text.description: kind=secret only. The password, key or file text; encrypted by this server before upload

ttl.description: kind=secret only. How long it stays readable, default 7d

note.description: kind=secret only. Your own note; the recipient never sees it

title.description: At most 200 Unicode code points. kind=secret: required, one line the recipient sees before opening; never the secret itself. HTML create: checks the existing static document head title before publishing, not stored metadata or script changes; omit when no check is needed.

public.description: True selects the shared public namespace. Conflicting namespace refuses. Omit for existing defaults; false disallows namespace=public.

namespace.description: Use public for the shared public namespace, or a custom namespace. Omit for existing defaults.

password.description: New reader password. Omit for no password. Send only the exact password requested, never a placeholder.

domain.description: Hostname on HTML-format pages or sites, with the required owning profile

linkName.description: Readable name for the public link of a page, site or file, with the required owning profile: 6-20 of a-z, 0-9 and hyphens, with a letter

template.description: Template slug for an HTML copy

tools.name: read_page_data
tools.title: Read page data
tools.description: Read saved visitor data on an owned HTML page or site. Leave out collection for settings and usage. Use collection for entries, include=files for uploads, countBy for totals, or format=csv or fileId for a protected download.

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

limit.description: Entries or files per page; default 20

tools.name: read_publication
tools.title: Read a BrewPage publication
tools.description: Read content, owner source, owner settings or statistics for a publication. Site content returns its manifest or named path. File content returns a download reference. KV without key lists keys. Continue long content with the returned offset. A secret ({"kind":"secret","id":<ref>} or its manage link) returns its state, views and open times, never its content.

kind.description: Publication kind returned by publish or list; secret with its ref as id

id.description: Publication id, or a secret's 10-character ref

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

view.description: Default content. HTML source, settings and stats are owner reads

path.description: Relative site file path. Omit for the owner manifest

password.description: Reader password when content is protected

offset.description: Next character offset from a previous read

tz.description: Stats only. IANA time zone, default UTC

tools.name: update_publication
tools.title: Replace BrewPage publication content
tools.description: Replace an existing publication using its kind and target or private manageUrl. A site update fully replaces its file bundle. File updates fetch a public HTTP(S) URL. KV writes one key. A missing publication is never created.

kind.description: Publication kind returned by publish or list; secret with its ref as id

id.description: Publication id, or a secret's 10-character ref

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

format.description: Omit to keep the saved format. Send html when replacing with HTML.

verbatim.description: Preserve inline source by default. False allows paste repair.

entry.description: Required for sites. Keep the existing entryFile unless changing it.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL fetched directly by the tool. No local download needed.

json.description: Pass objects/arrays directly: {"x":1}. Strings are stored as strings.

tags.description: Tags. Updates accept tags only on HTML and sites

state.description: Page data configuration for HTML-format pages and sites. {} enables, null disables on update

tools.name: write_page_data
tools.title: Write author entries
tools.description: Save up to 20 author entries in one Page data list. Use the last read version to replace only that version.

manageUrl.description: Private link as target and proof.

version.description: Last read version; sent as If-Match
